_note: ObliWAN import template (M1). Fill in the sections you need and delete the rest. UUIDs are optional; omit them to always create new records. Sites, devices, templates, revisions and variables join this template when the inventory (M2) and the template engine (M5) land.

deviceGroups._note: A top-level group. 'uuid' is optional — set one to allow idempotent re-imports.
deviceGroups.name: Retail

settings._note: Global setting. Keys and bounds are defined in shared/src/settings.ts (e.g. presence_grace_period, device_timeout, snmp_poll_interval, drift_interval, audit_retention_days). Values are numeric.
Group-level override — scopeUuid must match a deviceGroup uuid in this file.

notificationChannels._note: Notification channel plus its bindings. 'type' must be one of: webhook, slack, discord, telegram, email, gotify, ntfy, pushover, matrix.
notificationChannels.name: Slack #noc

bindings._note: Global binding — this channel receives everything. overrideMode: 'merge' (add to inherited) or 'replace' (replace inherited).
Group-scoped binding — only fires for this group and its descendants.

teams._note: A team plus its scoped permissions. 'scope' is 'group' or 'device'; device scope becomes usable once the inventory lands (M2). 'level' is 'ro' or 'rw'.
teams.name: Field technicians
teams.description: Read-only on the whole retail tree
